claims.cv_text: Optimized VP-SPCA for sparse dimensionality reduction using restarted FISTA, backtracking, and matrix-free randomized sketches, reducing subspace error by 30.7% versus default scikit-learn PCA on corrupted synthetic data.
claims.public_summary: Optimized VP-SPCA using restarted FISTA, backtracking, and matrix-free randomized sketches; accelerated VP-SPCA reduced subspace error by 30.7% versus default scikit-learn PCA on corrupted synthetic data.
limitations: The quoted recovery gain belongs to accelerated VP-SPCA; it is not an isolated causal effect of random sketches or acceleration.
The baseline is default dense scikit-learn PCA, not sparsity-matched thresholded PCA.
These are exposed synthetic-design seeds, not an independent confirmation or a universal accuracy claim.

claims.cv_text: Recovered three interpretable spatial modes and temporal dynamics in clean synthetic video; Huber-based Robust VP-SPCA separated low-rank structure from sparse corruption and reduced clean reconstruction error by 22.2% versus PCA.
claims.public_summary: Recovered three interpretable spatial modes and temporal dynamics in clean synthetic video; Huber-based Robust VP-SPCA separated low-rank structure from sparse corruption and reduced clean reconstruction error by about 22% versus PCA in the separate corrupted-video experiment.
limitations: The clean mode-recovery task and corrupted-video reconstruction task are separate experiments.
Historical display-only amplitude fitting is not evidence of native temporal-amplitude recovery; use the no-refit integrity figure.
The clean VP fit exhausted 500 iterations without strict convergence.
The fixed robust method improves clean reconstruction but has lower nominal-budget outlier F1 than PCA.
Closed negative cleaned-encoder v2 evidence stays supplementary, not a replacement for this baseline result.

claims.cv_text: Developed a randomized VP-SPCA pipeline for 1000 Genomes, retaining strong population separation with 5% of 455,102 SNPs while reducing modeling runtime by 29.1% versus all-SNP PCA across 20 paired splits.
claims.public_summary: Developed a randomized VP-SPCA pipeline for 1000 Genomes, retaining strong population separation with 5% of 455,102 SNPs while reducing modeling workflow time by 29.1% versus all-SNP PCA across 20 paired splits.
limitations: SNPs are selected using VP own loadings and independently refit by VP, not selected by PCA.
Retaining strong separation does not mean lossless or noninferior: balanced accuracy and AMR recall are lower than all-SNP PCA.
The 20 splits reuse the same 1000-person cohort and are not independent external-population validation.
VP uses a fixed 50-step budget and did not satisfy strict full-data stationarity.

Timing includes common preprocessing, full selection, panel materialization/refit, projection and readouts; it excludes download, upstream QC/LD, export/rendering and separately recorded independent audits.
First registered seed 2025 figures are illustrative; all predeclared penalties and 20-split aggregate statistics remain visible.
